sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The 📊 artwork-summary button stood taller than the buttons beside it, so the group it sits in no longer read as one control with a straight top and bottom edge. All of them are the same height again.

The rule that keeps those buttons aligned used to list them one by one, which is why a button added later was left out of it. It now matches them the way the grouping itself does, so anything added next is the right height without a further change.
